subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Hyperloop Vision
description: Learn The Hyperloop Vision in one minute.

hook.text: In 2013, Elon Musk proposed pods in near-vacuum tubes at 700 mph. He called it the fifth mode of transport.

buildup.text: Remove air from a tube and a pod inside faces almost no drag. It glides on magnetic levitation.

discovery.text: The concept promised speeds faster than airplanes at a fraction of the energy—physics supports it in theory.

twist.text: Maintaining a vacuum in a tube hundreds of miles long, through weather and earthquakes, is enormously hard.

climax.text: Several startups raised billions. By 2024, most had folded or pivoted. No commercial line exists.

punchline.text: The physics works. The engineering doesn't—yet.

quiz.question: What makes the Hyperloop concept theoretically energy-efficient?
options: Near-vacuum tubes eliminate almost all air resistance
